== Summary ==
[[Aron Eisenberg]] signing at [[DecipherCon 1999]] on 12 November 1999. Crop of Decipher's photograph fri30, whose full frame is [[:File:Bruce Umene DecipherCon 1999.jpg]]. Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999]], [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].

Identification: Decipher's fri30 caption reads "Tournaments Coordinator Bruce Umene does the macarena while Aron Eisenberg signs." Eisenberg is the man seated at the table, left of centre, head down and signing; he is the only person signing in the frame.
